questions.question: Imagine the number of votes for rugby doubles. Using the given scale, what will be its new height? Will it reach closer to the football bar or the hockey bar? Justify your reasoning.
questions.hint: Double the current votes for rugby and compare the new height to the existing bars.
questions.solution: Current rugby votes = 10. Doubled votes = 20. The scale is 1 unit = 5 votes, so 20 votes = 4 units. The hockey bar is at 15 votes (3 units), and the football bar is at 25 votes (5 units). 4 units is closer to 3 units (hockey) than to 5 units (football).
